implementation.summary: The migration and Runtime owner/consumer mechanisms were already present at base. Added behavioral witnesses for atomic publish recovery and actual serialized manifest consumption through the strict RunManifest DTO and Runtime path resolver, including a same-basename decoy.

acceptance_properties.property: Canonical CLI output preserves the addressable artifact identity through serialization and Runtime consumption.
acceptance_properties.mechanism: Creates run-root/nested/data.json and a different run-root/data.json; invokes the canonical CLI; parses the output with RunManifest.model_validate_json; resolves the loaded reference with resolve_artifact_path; asserts the nested path and nested source bytes.

acceptance_properties.property: A publish fault leaves existing input and destination intact, removes the temporary sibling, and allows a successful consumer-readable retry.
acceptance_properties.mechanism: Injects os.replace failure at atomic publication; checks prior output/input/source bytes and temp cleanup; retries through the CLI and reads the result through RunManifest plus resolve_artifact_path.
